title: SEDEX_ISO: A Pipeline for Stellar Spectral Energy Distribution and Isochrone Fitting
description: SEDEX_ISO is a Python-based pipeline that combines stellar spectral energy distribution (SED) fitting with isochrone-based inference of fundamental stellar parameters. It is developed as an extension of SEDEX (Yu et al. 2022) and incorporates modified code components from astroARIADNE (Vines & Jenkins 2022).
